thread.title: Samsung Electronics: 5G And AI Create A New Cycle - Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd. (OTCMKTS:SSNLF)

author: Hyundai Motor Investment & Securities
title: Samsung Electronics: 5G And AI Create A New Cycle - Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd. (OTCMKTS:SSNLF)
text:
1) Investment highlights We maintain BUY and our six-month-forward target price of KRW66,000 (the average of 10x 2018F EPS and 1.7x 2018F BPS, after the stock split) on Samsung Electronics ( OTC:SSNLF )( OTC:SSNNF ). We now believe Samsung will report KRW61.2tn in revenue and KRW15.7tn in operating profit for 2Q18, mostly unchanged from our previous estimates. We slightly raise our 2Q operating profit forecast is because we expect DRAM prices to increase more sharply than we previously thought. In 2Q, we estimate the PC DRAM contract price to rise 4.7% QoQ and the server DRAM price to climb by a higher-than-expected 2.8% QoQ on the back of data center demand. As for mobile DRAM, the prices of discrete products may rise slightly, by more than 1%, but the prices of those for eMCP will likely remain flat QoQ.
Samsung shares have been underperforming SK Hynix ( OTC:HXSCL ) and Micron ( MU ) shares because of anemic smartphone demand, which has eclipsed favorable memory semiconductor fundamentals and dragged down the earnings of other business divisions. Considering the bright outlook for the display business from 3Q18 related to the new Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ) iPhone, we expect to see more bullish stock performance vs. other pure memory semiconductor plays.
2) Major issues and earnings outlook Micron shares hit a new high following the recent FY2Q18 results announcement, mainly because: 1) the company revealed a plan to buy back USD10bn worth of shares; 2) explosive growth in data consumption fueled by AI and data centers is creating a new industry cycle that is unlike cycles in the past; 3) and it is stressed that such a cycle signifies not only a structural change but a movement toward sounder, better fundamentals. It should be noted that a slew of players—telcos, solution providers, manufacturers, not to mention cloud computing companies—are all clamoring to set up their own data centers. Intel’s ( INTC ) CPU sales generated by its data center customers surged 19.6% YoY in the previous quarter, which worked to turn whatever skepticism there might have been toward data center demand into a certainty. We believe 5G phase 1 will begin in 2020; if phase 2 starts in 2022, 5G, which is 20 times faster than LTE, should be able to bring a further advancement in the UX of AI. 5G, in our view, will take data consumption to another level and drive memory chip demand higher.
3) Share price outlook and valuation We recommend a buy-and-hold strategy in light of: 1) strong earnings; 2) a favorable shareholder return policy; and 3) attractive valuation.
Disclosure: I/we have no positions in any stocks mentioned, and no plans to initiate any positions within the next 72 hours.
